rumble.guide.pokemon_inventory.title: Open Pokémon Summary and Item Slots
rumble.guide.pokemon_inventory.summary: View a party member and its item slots.
rumble.guide.pokemon_inventory.body: Select a party member, then press %1$s to open its summary. In real-time combat, press %2$s for the controlled Pokémon. The item slot below the portrait displays the held item or cosmetic.
rumble.guide.pokemon_moves.title: Change Pokémon Moves
rumble.guide.pokemon_moves.summary: Put learned moves into the four combat slots.
rumble.guide.pokemon_moves.body: Press %s and open the Moves tab. Select a move and use its swap button, then choose a learned move from the list. Real-time combat uses these four slots in order.
rumble.guide.realtime_combat.title: Real-Time Combat
rumble.guide.realtime_combat.summary: Challenge a wild Pokémon, then move, lock on and use moves.
rumble.guide.realtime_combat.body: Aim at a wild Pokémon and press %1$s to start real-time combat. Your selected partner is sent out first if needed. Aiming at empty space uses normal send/recall, allowing your partner to follow. In combat use movement keys, %2$s for basic attacks and hotbar bindings 1–4 for moves. Use %3$s to dodge, %4$s to lock on and %5$s to toggle real-time control of a following partner. Exiting leaves your partner out. Each defeated catchable wild Pokémon is stored separately in your PC.
rumble.guide.pokemon_held_items.title: Give a Held Item
rumble.guide.pokemon_held_items.summary: Give your deployed partner a battle item.
rumble.guide.pokemon_held_items.body: If you are controlling your partner, press %1$s to leave it deployed. Hold the item in your main hand, look at your partner, and hold %2$s while pressing %3$s. Choose Give Held Item from the interaction wheel. Held items and cosmetics use different slots.
